firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently read a fairy tale goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Before play, everyone secretly looks at three tiles. The first player then reveals a tile; turns proceed clockwise.
